title: Cosmic Purple Entity
description: A large surreal purple octopus-like creature with a white cat-like mask face, orange eyes, and dripping tentacles dominates the center. It holds glowing social media icons while surrounded by NFL football helmets and jerseys, a gothic cathedral, a golden trophy, floating gold coins, fairies, and two women standing on red platforms.
prompt: A massive purple tentacled cosmic entity with a white feline mask and glowing orange eyes emerges from swirling nebulae, its long tentacles dripping and holding glowing TikTok and social media icons. Below it are NFL football helmets, jerseys, a gothic cathedral, a golden trophy on a red stage with a curly-haired man in a green jersey, two glamorous women in dresses on platforms, flying fairies, and cascading gold coins against a starry night sky.
